text: {"name":"ble_conn_event_check","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Processes a pending BLE event by walking a linked list of connection contexts and incrementing an event counter for contexts whose connection index cannot be resolved with ble_conn_get.","subsystem":"ble","var_renames":{"v0":"event_ctx","v1":"conn_ctx","v3":"conn_idx"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":8,"meaning":"event_ctx: connection/event counter cleared before scan"},{"offset":28,"meaning":"event_ctx: trigger or enable flag"},{"offset":0,"meaning":"conn_ctx: next pointer in linked list"},{"offset":106,"meaning":"conn_ctx: state/flag; zero entries are considered"},{"offset":108,"meaning":"conn_ctx: active/ready flag"},{"offset":116,"meaning":"conn_ctx: connection index; 0xff denotes invalid"}]}
